work.note: The glow of a node that needs attention is drawn as circles around it, and they paint on top of everything in front of them. Rich 2026-09-29: it should be behind, and it should be the light emission of the material, real and physical, not raw circles.
work.task: Make a node that needs attention give off light from its own material, spread by the bloom, and remove the circles. Then draw the glass with the transmission material of drei, in its vanilla form, with what it adds over the physical material: chromatic aberration, distortion, the backside. VIEW-029 and VIEW-025.
work.resolution: Built on branch worktree-agent-a3feaec828d020c42 (from chassis), commits aa4588c, a0dc556, 2e9ff1e, not pushed. The circles are removed: a node that needs attention gives off light from its own glass (emissive to 2.6 in the signal's color), spread by the bloom pass, which reads the scene's depth so the glow stays behind anything nearer the eye; the pass stays on while such a record is open, so highlights and dots do not blink with each flash. The wave's pulse is emission too. The glass is drei's MeshTransmissionMaterial from @pmndrs/vanilla 1.25.0, vendored unchanged with license and hash, loaded through an import map the page policy allows by hash; its far wall is drawn as drei's component draws it, into two half-size pictures. Found and fixed: the bloom's mix darkened nodes on non-black themes, and the render chain cleared its buffer with the background in the screen's color space. Software renderer, 107 nodes, 1600x900: physical glass 8.5 fps, drei glass 11.7, no glass 15. Open: with the approved frosting and absorption the drei color split and bending hardly show.
